fieldValues.comment_text: Evidence from the srs-web lenses assessment (2026-10-09, srs-programme:source-documents/srs-web-lenses-2026-10-09/assessment.md#evidence). A cold reviewer of the proof of concept found that showing a record as its schema form (labels, required markers, field guidance, an Edit button) left them unable to tell "whether you are reading or administering", and that a lens named "The case" showed twenty claim forms rather than an argument. This supports the belief in SP-19 from the interface side: the record shape the tool needs is not the shape the reader holds. The suggested lens remedy makes the centre pane depend on the lens: reading, a rendered document, or a writing surface.
